m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited crew doctrine + the g5 handoff + g1 gate_spec/floor/holdout, g4 model, 624 baseline, PLAN_CRITIC_DISPOSITIONS. Verify handoff complete. Attest c1.

m1-harness.title: Build gate_f6.py F6 held-out harness + emit JSON
m1-harness.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/gate_f6.py: IMPORT frozen g1 gate_spec (do not re-derive), fit WeekendStateModel on TRAIN only, evaluate held-out car-signal vs paired held-out floor via gate_spec.evaluate_gate [F1+F2], add tc1 per-axis coverage floor (>=5 covered car-seasons), leave-one-layer-out ablation [F4], emit HONEST verdict. Run it to write docs/physics/626-f6-holdout-gate.json. Test-after: single green postcondition.

postconditions.statement: harness runs foreground, writes JSON with verdict + per-axis table + ablation

m2-test.title: test_gate_f6.py — runs end-to-end, emits verdict, does NOT require PASS
m2-test.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_gate_f6.py asserting the harness runs end-to-end and emits a verdict (PASS or DID-NOT-BEAT-FLOOR) with per-axis table + ablation. MUST NOT require PASS. Green.

postconditions.statement: test passes; does not require PASS

constraints: test must not require a PASS verdict

m3-docs.title: Writeup docs/physics/626-phase2-weekend-state-model.md
m3-docs.imperative: Author the writeup: four layers + per-layer sigma, why L2 floats, L3 cake-and-eat-it, F6 held-out result table + verdict + noise margin + coverage, per-layer ablation, Mexico-vs-Monaco density secondary, honest-null status. Narrate the JSON. Match 624/625 precedent.
